The '''Imperial Re-education Center''' was a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and brainwashing facility operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Ternion Building]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Re-education Center appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
